walls.note: The south side wall along the lane (BAG edge 17, 24.4 m), the cream corner house's flank. walls.note: Rokin front of the Hajenius house (BAG edges 19-7, 16.7 m with the 3DBAG jogs; this brief wall is only its north 5.4 m, the items run the whole front), read on the same 2025 and 2018 whole-face crops (36 px/m, h = (905 - y) / 36; the main cornice at 19.6-20.1 m sits on the 3DBAG's 70th-percentile roof). Light sandstone; three equal bays between four pilasters (triple, single, triple windows, symmetric about the middle bay), then a narrower north end bay with its own pilasters under a curved gable crown with an oculus. A high ground zone (shop to 4.85 m, a row of wide windows at 5.3-7.8 m) under a string course at 8.75-9.1 m; three storeys of windows (9.2-11.5, 12.4-14.9, 15.75-18.2 m) with oval paterae in the spandrels; a slate mansard with three small dormers behind the cornice.
